excerpt.zh: 是时候了。暗藏在整个星系各处的特工都在等待密码指令，并根据指令行动。星海帝国的落幕之战就从此时奏响。
excerpt.en: It is time. Concealed operatives all over the galaxy are waiting for the code phrase that will send them into action. This is the beginning of the end of the Galactic Imperium.

texts.zh: 是时候了。暗藏在整个星系各处的特工都在等待密码指令，并根据指令行动。星海帝国的落幕之战就从此时奏响。
texts.en: It is time. Concealed operatives all over the galaxy are waiting for the code phrase that will send them into action. This is the beginning of the end of the Galactic Imperium.

texts.zh: 星海帝国现已成功地撑过了席卷全境的暴乱风波！随着帝国重掌权威，公开叛乱的可能已经微乎其微。我们可以撤回特工了。
texts.en: The Imperium has somehow managed to weather the storm of turmoil and instability that was only recently sweeping across it! With Imperial authorities now firmly back in control, conditions are no longer favorable for an open revolt. Our operatives have been withdrawn.

label.zh: 我们现在应当等待时机……
label.en: We shall bide our time for now...
